description: This file defines an interface 'HttpEndpoint' in Java, which extends the 'Endpoint' interface and declares a method to add HTTP routes to a Vert.x router. It is part of an Eclipse-based project and provides a contract for handling HTTP requests in the service.

classes.name: HttpEndpoint
classes.description: Interface defining an HTTP endpoint capable of adding HTTP routes via Vert.x Router.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Adds custom routes to the provided Vert.x Router for handling HTTP requests.
